acceptance: update_item with not_before set to an empty string clears the hold and the item is claimable immediately (test or live proof)
A documented way adds text to context or description without overwriting concurrent edits, or the replace-only behaviour is stated in the tool description
context:
Seen while closing items held until 2026-11-02 after the calendar waits were waived: clearing with an empty string was accepted but the hold stayed. The note-prepend workaround reads then rewrites the whole context field.

Tracked in the todo-db tracker as update-item-not-before-clear (copied 2026-10-28).

RESOLVED 2026-10-29: BenchBox runs todo-db 0.11.0 (BenchBox-dev/benchbox#3725, merge a554c997f; release https://github.com/joeharris76/todo-db/releases/tag/v0.11.0). Criterion 1: not_before="" clears the hold and the item is claimable at once (test_empty_not_before_clears_a_hold_over_mcp). Criterion 2: context_append adds text without overwriting concurrent edits, and the update_item description states that text fields are replaced whole (todo-db#52).

Probe 2026-10-29: context_append accepted by update_item.
description: update_item with not_before set to an empty string does not clear a hold, so an item held to a future date cannot be released early; the only workaround is to set not_before a few seconds ahead, wait, then take. update_item also replaces text fields wholesale, so adding a note to context requires reading the field and writing it back. Both cost extra steps and risk overwriting concurrent edits.
